title.en: The Story of the Western Wing

review.en: A young scholar and a minister's daughter meet in a monastery, and a quick-witted maid carries their letters. Wang Shifu turned an old Tang tale into a long zaju play whose sung verses are among the most admired lyrics in Chinese drama. Its warmth toward young love made it loved, and sometimes banned, for centuries.
review.zh: 书生张生在普救寺遇见相国小姐崔莺莺，丫鬟红娘在两人之间传书递简。王实甫把唐人《莺莺传》以来的故事写成多本连演的杂剧，曲词秾丽流转，被称作元杂剧的压卷之作。它对青年人情感的同情，让它被读者珍爱了几百年。
